design.expected_scale: Up to 50 online players and 10 concurrent sessions.
state_owners: one session map owned by the initiating player
design.hot_path_budget: One narrow event; no global tick, scan or forced chunk.
design.concurrency: A token replaces the previous session; stale writers stop.
design.persistence_reload: Session is transient and cleanup runs before reload.
design.failure_cleanup: Every exit after acquisition calls example_cleanup.

route_decision.rationale: Exact target Meta satisfies the capability with the smallest blast radius; console and Reflect routes remain rejected alternatives.
